title: Make brand videos and run social accounts with an agent
summary: Shaitrish's open-source 37Studio has Claude Code build on-brand videos from a brief, post them to nine social platforms, and draft replies to messages and comments.
agent_role: The agent builds a brand library from a website, makes and renders each video, checks its own frames, writes captions per platform and drafts replies. Humans brief videos, approve posts and replies, and set spending limits.
what_they_did: Shaitrish, a software team in Dhaka, built 37Studio, a free app that runs on your own computer. You paste a brand's website and it collects logos, colours and facts. You brief a video and Claude Code builds it, checks its frames and renders it. It can then post to nine platforms on a schedule and draft replies in one inbox.
worth_knowing: The agent can read the AI keys and files inside its container, so the safety allowlist is not a true security wall. You also need 16 GB of memory and your own app set up for each social platform.
prompt: Using 37Studio, add my brand from [website URL] and build its brand library. Then make a [length]-second [type of video, e.g. hook reel] about [topic] in the brand's style, using my footage in [folder]. Check your own frames before rendering. Write a caption for each of [platforms]. Show me the finished video and captions and wait for my approval before posting anything. Ask me before spending more than [budget] on generated images, video or voice.

curation.rationale: An open-source app where Claude Code builds on-brand videos, checks its own frames, posts to nine platforms and drafts inbox replies. The README mostly lists features rather than reporting real use, but it describes a concrete multi-step agent workflow with code available.
